column3: nāradād yāś ca munayo yamaṁ dharmabhṛtāṁ varam |
praṇamya sukham āsīnaṁ vṛddhaṁ jñānavidāṁ varam ||
śiraḥ prāvṛtya vastreṇa pidhāyāsyaṁ kareṇa ca ||
na kedāre na setau ca nāśucau na ca bhūruhe ||
dantaśuddhiṁ ca yaḥ kuryāt pacyate narakādinā ||
pūrvam uddhṛtatoyena śaucaṁ kuryāt tathā mṛdā ||
nānyaśiṣṭāṁ ca nārdrāṁ ca śaucārthaṁ mṛdam āharet ||
gudeṣṭābhir dvādaśabhiḥ mṛdbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiś ca vā |
nyūnādhikān akartavyā asaṁkhyāś ca vṛthā bhavet |
yāvad gandhakṣayo vāpi śaucaṁ kuryād viśuddhaye ||
nocet pitṝn bhakṣayati svayaṁ cāśucitāṁ vrajet ||
liṅgeti saḥ kare vāme daśāsapta ca dakṣiṇe |
aivaṁ malavisarge tu mūtraśauce tu kathyate |
ekāliṅge kare tisraḥ dve vā pañca ca hastayoḥ ||
savyahastaṁ bahir jānau apaśyaiva tad antarā |
evaṁ śocaṁ dvijaḥ kṛtvā ājānukṣālayet pade ||
śaucamitthaṁ gṛhasthasya varṇī tu dviguṇaṁ caret |
triguṇaṁ tu vanasthasya yatīnāṁ tu caturguṇam ||
strīśūdrāṇāṁ yathā śocaṁ sarveṣāṁ ca manaḥ śuciḥ |
kṛtvā dvādaśagaṇḍūṣaṁ malasūtre tu ṣaḍ bhavet ||
praveśayet karaṁ savyaṁ jale cāmaṇi bandhanam |
samantrakam aśabdaṁ ca hṛdayasthe jale punaḥ |
madhye madhye jalaṁ spṛśya tattad evaṁ su cintayet |
parimṛśya dvir āsyaṁ tu sakṛd oṣṭhau parispṛśet ||
tvaṁ nyūnam adhikaṁ pītaṁ sureti kavayo viduḥ ||
vyāhṛtībhiś caturvāraṁ triḥ pibet praṇavena vā |
sāvitryā va pibed ambū triḥ pibed vāpy āmantrakam ||
pibe ca brahmatīrthe na divā vīkṣya jalaṁ pibet ||
pibed vipro jale hyasthe karmasthe bāhujaḥ punaḥ |
vaiśyāśūdrās tathā nārya āsyasthe ca punāti ca ||
kāghāsaiḥ kramukaiḥ kāśaiḥ kharguraś ca niṣiddhajaiḥ ||
na kurddantasi śuddhyaṁ ca kṛtvā sadyo tyajo bhavet |
evaṁ dantānūśucī kṛtvā punar ācamya buddhimān |
saṁkalpya vidhipūrvaṁ tu tataḥ snātum upakramet ||
āpo hiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ mārjayen mūrdhni vāṣṭabhiḥ ||
kāveryās tu sakṛt toyair brahmahatyāṁ vyapohati ||
sūrye pradarśyo dityam iti devasya tveti gṛhya ca |
prokṣayitvā nipī ayāyaṁ yekeceti ca maṁtrataḥ |
vāma? prakoṣṭhe nikṣipya dvir ācamya viśudhyati ||
āpo hiṣṭhādibhir maṁtraiḥ śīrasi prokṣayej jalaiḥ ||
vyastamaṁtrair viśudhya syāt samastai brahmahā bhavet |
na prokṣayet xironyatra brahmahatyāṁ sa viṁdati ||
ādityābhimukhas tv arghyaṁ datvā tīraṁsam āgataḥ |
saṁtārpya keśavādīṁś ca gṛhānś cācamya vai kramāt |
upaviśya śucau deśo prā mukheṣv āsaneṣu ca ||
ṛṣiśchaṁdaḥ svarāṁ spṛtvā prāṇāyāmam athā caret |
triḥ paṭhen niyatāt māyaḥ prāṇāyāmam ixṁ viduḥ |
tat pāpaṁ tu kṣiped bhūmau coravaṁtī charaṁtakaḥ |
manasā niṣṭaciṁtāś ca pareṣāṁ ca tathāśane |
ādyaṁ tayos tu gāyatryā prāṇāyāmatrayaṁ caret ||
daśādhāmātṛkā nyāsān kuryād vipro yathā balaṁ |
punarmūrdhnimux nyais yā ṣo aśāpi svarāḥ kramāt |
vinyasec caturaḥ kādīn karavatyaṁ ca saviṣu ||
